blurb: Boasting the very best greens in Connecticut, Indian Springs is a scenic, challenging, 9-hole, par 36 public golf course in the center of the state. Designed by Al Zikorus and opened by Alan Parmelee, it has served the golfing community of Connecticut since 1964. The Parmelee family continues to operate the course with meticulous care.
